llm.summary: The two-tower initially allocates 1.51 times more demand to cluster C8 compared to C6, but this shifts to 1.36x after adjusting for an alpha value of 0.75. Exposure to demand becomes less distant from both C8 and C6 by reducing the distance from 0.113 to 0.086 and 0.195 to 0.167 respectively, measured using item-kNN. In terms of user impact, the hit rate increases slightly in C3 from 0.076 to 0.089, benefiting 14,451 users, while decreasing in C0 from 0.040 to 0.037, affecting 9,964 users negatively. Additionally, item-kNN outperforms the adjusted two-tower in C4, where it has a larger advantage of 0.059 versus 0.048, impacting 7,326 users positively.
